title: 第19章 武魂再度进化战绩惊人青莲异动第20章 源石武魂变化圣女心悸
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆
content_zh:
;;
“这……”
洛凡尘觉得眼前的一幕似曾相识，记得小泥鳅上一次这样还是上一次。
女教皇的圣女愣住了，都准备走了，没想到洛凡尘的武魂能突然异动。
看到小泥鳅将魂环吞入口中，白莹玥焦急道：
“不好！”
“小师哥你快控制武魂停下来，要是附加这二百年魂环，你的天赋就浪费了！！！”
“来不及了。”帝薇央叹息道，这小泥鳅吞的太快了，连她都没反应过来。
看来洛凡尘只能附加二百年的魂环了。
“唰！”
小泥鳅全身散发单色光芒。
光芒愈发强盛深邃，它的体型也在迅速扩张，体表的鳞片不断滋生，位格攀升。
白莹玥诧异道：“这……这也不是附加魂环的动静啊。”
帝薇央凤眸凝视。
“轰！”
小泥鳅体型从先前的小臂大小，扩张了足足一倍，少说也有一米余长。
卖相明显比先前威武许多，不再是小泥鳅，而是青鳞小蛇，体表散发着双色光芒，不再是先前的单色。
洛凡尘明显能感知到青鳞小蛇传来的喜悦情绪，内心升起明悟。
它变长了，也变强了。
不过你这小老弟不厚道啊，自己吃也不给主人分一口。

白莹玥震惊道：“小师哥这武魂竟然真的可以持续进化，而且这进化的速度未免也太快了吧。”
“有趣。”帝薇央唇角上扬，颔首道：“世间竟有此等武魂，不知道进化的终点在哪里。”
“师妹，你说什么来着？”洛凡尘刚才把心思都放在小泥鳅晋级上了。
“诶呀！”白莹玥俏脸出现惋惜之色：“你这武魂可以不断进化，潜力何等了得，第一魂环只附加两百年的太可惜了。”
洛凡尘感应了一下，摇头道：“没有，没感应到你说的魂环啊。”
“怎么可能没有?”
白莹玥黑靴美腿一跺，亲身示范，背后一轮紫色冷月升起，寒气四溢，周围温度骤然下降。
洛凡尘手脚冰凉，暗道这武魂非同小可，白莹玥明显收敛气息，还能让他感到阵阵寒意。
“唰唰！”
黄黄紫紫，四道光环自紫月内部浮现而出，上下律动。
白莹玥解释道：“你看，这是我的九品顶级武魂，太阴幽莹，已经附加了四道魂环。”
洛凡尘有样学样，催动魂力，青鳞小蛇在虚空游弋，但并无魂环出现。
他肯定的说道：“确实没有，那魂环应该是被我这武魂当养料消化掉了。”
白莹玥发出惊呼：
“怎么可能！魂环只能附加在武魂上，而无法被吸收成个人的力量是公认的啊！！！”

"This..."
Luo Fanchen felt that the scene in front of him seemed familiar, and he remembered the last time Little Loach was like this.
The female pope and the saints were stunned and were about to leave. They didn't expect Luo Fanchen's martial spirit to suddenly move.
Seeing the little loach swallowing the soul ring into its mouth, Bai Yingyue said anxiously:
"Not good!"
"Brother, please control your martial soul and stop it. If you attach this two-hundred-year-old soul ring, your talent will be wasted!!!"
"It's too late." Di Weiyang sighed. The little loach swallowed it so fast that she didn't even react.
It seems that Luo Fanchen can only attach two hundred years of soul rings.
"Uh-huh!"
The whole body of the little loach emits a monochromatic light.
The light is getting stronger and deeper, and its size is also rapidly expanding. The scales on its body are growing, and its status is rising.
Bai Yingyue said in surprise: "This...this is not the movement of attaching a soul ring."
Di Weiyang stared with phoenix eyes.
"Boom!"
The size of the little loach has doubled from the previous size of a forearm, to at least one meter in length.
The appearance is obviously much more majestic than before. It is no longer a small loach, but a small green-scaled snake. The body surface is emitting two-color light, no longer the previous single color.
Luo Fanchen could clearly feel the joy coming from the little green-scaled snake, and enlightenment arose in his heart.
It grew longer and stronger.
But you little brother is not kind. You eat it yourself and don’t give a bite to your master.
Bai Yingyue said in shock: "My martial soul can really continue to evolve, and the speed of evolution is too fast."
"Interesting." Di Weiyang raised the corners of her lips and nodded: "There are such martial spirits in the world. I don't know where the end point of evolution is."
"Junior sister, what are you talking about?" Luo Fanchen had just focused on Little Loach's advancement.
"Hey!" A look of regret appeared on Bai Yingyue's pretty face: "Your martial soul can continue to evolve, and its potential is so great. It's a pity that the first soul ring only attaches two hundred years."
Luo Fanchen sensed it, shook his head and said, "No, I didn't sense the soul ring you mentioned."
"How could it not be?"
Bai Yingyue stamped her beautiful legs in black boots and demonstrated in person. A cold purple moon rose behind her, and the cold air overflowed, and the surrounding temperature suddenly dropped.
Luo Fanchen's hands and feet were cold, and he secretly thought that this martial spirit was no small matter. Bai Yingyue's aura was obviously restrained, and it could still make him feel chilly.
"Swish!"
Yellow, yellow, purple, and purple, four haloes emerged from the inside of the purple moon, moving up and down.
Bai Yingyue explained: "Look, this is my ninth-grade top martial soul, Taiyin Youying, which has four soul rings attached to it."
Luo Fanchen followed suit, activated his soul power, and the green-scaled snake swam in the void, but no soul ring appeared.
He said with certainty: "Indeed not, that soul ring should have been digested by my martial soul as nourishment."
Bai Yingyue exclaimed:
"How is that possible! It is generally accepted that soul rings can only be attached to martial souls and cannot be absorbed into personal power!!!"
